target: VII cross-world search, availability, supplier refresh, conversions and booking closure
natural_destination: The exact public release at https://vii.spaplus.co plus authenticated admin routes.

requirements.statement: Undated discovery uses last-known capability without claiming dated availability.
Dated searches show authoritative matching availability or an honest recovery state.
Location, party, filters, URL, count, cards and map remain consistent.
Supplier failures preserve safe cached discovery and block false transaction confirmation.
Booking is idempotent and submitted at most once.

risks.risk: A no-date search returns zero or waits on the provider despite a valid capability cache.
A dated search shows unavailable or wrong-context results.
A valid city with no exact inventory returns 404 instead of nearby recovery.
A provider or exact-period cache failure blanks all discovery.
Sensitive conversion data leaks to an unauthorized client.

cases.action: Open undated all-country search, enable online booking, reload and return from a result
cases.oracle: Immediate non-empty online-capable results; URL, chip, count and state persist; no dated-availability claim

cases.preconditions: A live future vacation date and party have at least one supplier result
cases.action: Search by dates and party, open a result, return and reload
cases.oracle: Only matching available results appear and date/party/location state remains identical

cases.preconditions: Valid hourly city with no exact inventory
cases.action: Search Haifa and Haifa/Carmel on desktop and mobile
cases.oracle: HTTP 200 with honest nearby recovery or empty guidance, never 404 or unrelated first record

cases.preconditions: Requested period cache is absent but a sibling accepted snapshot exists
cases.action: Load home and regional near-term rails
cases.oracle: One bounded fallback selects truthful accepted data; no visitor-time retry loop and no blank rail

cases.preconditions: Events, spa and hourly routes are public
cases.action: Run representative no-date and dated/filter searches in each world
cases.oracle: Each route returns 200 and the visible result state matches its world, URL and active filters

cases.preconditions: Search drawer, filters or calendar are open on mobile
cases.action: Resize to desktop, reload, return to mobile and rotate
cases.oracle: No stale lock, blank page, horizontal drift or lost valid search state

cases.action: Request it without admin session and then with authorized session
cases.oracle: Unauthorized is 403; authorized aggregate is schema-valid; token and raw contacts never reach the client
cases.evidence: Anonymous 403 is recorded in project_knowledge/release_evidence/vii-operational-closure-20261022/v574-gap-closeout-availability.json#TC-07. Authenticated production read for vacation-2566, 2026-09-23 through 2026-10-22, returned a schema-valid aggregate with 9 contacts split by source and no raw contacts, token or credential.

cases.preconditions: Authorized admin selects a business with zero and non-zero periods
cases.oracle: True zero, loading and provider error are distinct; selection is preserved without invented metrics

cases.preconditions: Verified Roy place, quote and one reserved partnerRef
cases.action: Read ref, submit once if absent, read back; simulate uncertain response in automated test
cases.oracle: Exactly one booking exists; uncertainty triggers GET only and no second POST

cases.preconditions: Capability, discovery and supplier timestamps are available
cases.action: Compare freshness, expiry and last-good boundaries
cases.oracle: Expired data is not called current; safe stale discovery remains usable; final booking always revalidates live
